newsitem.title: DUBAI: 18 killed as Saudi building collapses - paper.
newsitem.headline: 18 killed as Saudi building collapses - paper.

text.p: At least 18 people were killed and 15 were injured when a four-storey building collapsed in Saudi Arabia on Friday, a Saudi newspaper said on Saturday.
Rescue teams rushed to the site to save residents trapped under the debris of the building in the governorate of Yanbu on the Red Sea coast, the English-language Arab News added.
It gave no other details. Saudi officials were not immediately available for comment.
